Coding agent risks with Redis: replays and fixes

1 replay involves Redis: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • redis-cli FLUSHALL against a URL

    Fix: Give the agent a Redis ACL user (Redis 6 or later) with only +@read, or with +@all -@dangerous -flushall -flushdb, so it cannot run FLUSHALL or FLUSHDB: key patterns do not limit those commands. Keep the production REDIS_URL out of the agent environment.

    Replay result: Stopped.
